rule: storms since 1980 whose best track, interpolated linearly at 10-minute steps, came within 100 km of nearest of the 78 municipio internal points (TIGERweb); plus Hugo 1989, Georges 1998, Irma 2017, María 2017, Fiona 2022 regardless. closest_km is the distance to that reference, not to the coastline. Radii r34/r50/r64 are [NE, SE, SW, NW] in nautical miles, null where HURDAT2 has -999.
